thread:
niko: Running into weird 429s in the rust sampleapp when using websocket streaming + background paginator. Burst happens right after STS refresh + ws reconnect. anyone familiar with rust-sdk quirks here?

tara: which rust-sdk version and how are you doing prefetch + streams?

niko: rust-sdk 0.2.0-beta. we open a long-lived websocket for streaming token-by-token generation, and a separate async task that prefetches next pages (embeds/rerank) over REST. STS rotates every 60s in our test. After rotation the ws reconnects and prefetch resumes immediately -> burst of requests and per-client quota trips.

kevin: captured headers from failures: x-ratelimit-limit:120, x-ratelimit-remaining:0, x-ratelimit-reset:2645550300, x-client-session:rust:ws_conn_42

ws-bot: note: websockets often create a new socket id on reconnect; if server keys session by socket+token that looks like many new clients.

tara: quick mitigation: 1) when auth rotates, pause prefetch for a randomized window (200-1200ms) and avoid immediately reconnecting WS aggressively; 2) reuse the same ws connection where possible (post-auth handshake) or coordinate reconnect backoffs so only one reconnect happens at a time.

niko: implemented pause=800ms + jitter and serialized ws reconnects (only one reconnect attempt per process). reduced 429s but not eliminated under high concurrency from CI.

kevin: also check whether your prefetch task cancels/reschedules inflight requests on token change. duplicated inflight + immediate retries can push you over quota. cancel inflight on rotate and then resume after cooldown.

niko: cancelled inflight + single reconnect + jittered resume -> mostly mitigated. curious if server can accept a stable client-id header even when token flips so session sticks.

devdocs: good idea. I'll add a short "Rust streaming + prefetch" recipe to the sampleapp docs: reuse WS where possible, pause/cancel prefetch on auth rotate, serialize reconnects, and add jitter. I'll open PR #4902 with example code.

tara: small SDK note: we should ensure the rust client exposes a convenient "pause_prefetch_on_auth" helper and a shared connection manager to avoid users implementing ad-hoc logic. filing an SDK task.

niko: thanks all 44d will attach a tiny repro that flips STS and runs prefetch+stream concurrently. happy to run infra traces if needed.
